shop.list.title: Shop management
shop.list.subtitle: Manage your shops and choose one that's trading normally as your current shop.
shop.list.empty.title: No shops yet
shop.resubmit.rejectReasonFallback: The reviewer left no reason; you can resubmit as is or pick another name
shop.create.title: Open a new shop
shop.create.subtitle: Just enter a shop name and submit — you can start trading once the platform approves it.
shop.subaccount.title: Sub-accounts
shop.subaccount.subtitle: Sub-accounts of “{name}”. Each signs in with its own login name and password, and carries this shop with it.
shop.subaccount.new.title: New sub-account
shop.subaccount.new.desc: Give a staff member a separate sign-in identity: login name, their own phone number and an initial password. They activate it by verifying the phone number on first sign-in.
shop.subaccount.new.passwordPlaceholder: Tell them to change it soon after you hand it over
shop.subaccount.new.done: Sub-account created — waiting for phone verification
shop.subaccount.list.title: Sub-accounts
shop.subaccount.empty.title: No sub-accounts yet
shop.subaccount.empty.body: Create one above; once activated they can run day-to-day work in the workbench
shop.subaccount.disable.confirm.title: Disable sub-account
shop.subaccount.disable.confirm.desc: Once disabled, “{loginName}” can no longer sign in to this shop and any active session ends. You can enable it again later.
shop.subaccount.enable.confirm.title: Enable sub-account
shop.subaccount.enable.confirm.desc: Enable “{loginName}”. If they never verified a phone number, it goes back to not-activated.
shop.subaccount.remove.confirm.title: Remove sub-account
shop.subaccount.remove.confirm.desc: Removing “{loginName}” cannot be undone — they will never be able to sign in to this shop with that identity again.
shop.subaccount.reset.title: Reset sign-in password
shop.subaccount.reset.desc: Set a new sign-in password for “{loginName}”; they will use it on their next sign-in.
shop.subaccount.permission.edit.title: Permissions for “{loginName}”
shop.subaccount.phone.failed: Couldn't view the sub-account's phone number
